# Brigita

> Brigita is a global enterprise AI, cloud, and digital transformation company offering end-to-end solutions from strategy to implementation.

Brigita provides comprehensive services spanning generative AI, cloud infrastructure, application development, data engineering, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. The company also offers proprietary AI platforms including BriGEN (GenAI suite), Nockpoint (AI app engine), Warelo (AI readiness platform), Vyoma (ESG sustainability AI), and Milvo (enterprise intelligence).

## Key Topics

- Generative AI (GenAI)
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Large Language Models (LLM)
- Enterprise AI
- Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- DevOps & CI/CD
- Data Engineering & Analytics
- SaaS Platforms
- MVP Development
- AI Readiness & Transformation
- Cybersecurity
- Product Engineering
- Digital Transformation
- ESG & Sustainability
- AI Consulting & Strategy

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://brigita.co/services): Complete service portfolio: AI, cloud, app development, cybersecurity, UX/UI, and digital marketing solutions
- [Generative AI Solutions](https://brigita.co/genai-solutions): Custom LLMs, RAG systems, intelligent automation, and enterprise AI integration
- [AI Consulting](https://brigita.co/ai-consulting): GenAI strategy, ML implementation, intelligent automation, and digital transformation roadmaps
- [Application Development](https://brigita.co/application-development-adems): Full-stack, cloud-native, and mobile development using Flutter, React Native, and modern frameworks
- [Cloud Infrastructure](https://brigita.co/cloud-infrastructure): Multi-cloud solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP with DevOps, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code
- [Data Engineering](https://brigita.co/data-engineering): ETL pipelines, cloud data integration, analytics platforms, and BI tools like Power BI and Tableau
- [Product Engineering](https://brigita.co/product-engineering): MVP development, cloud-native architecture, SaaS products, and agile delivery methodologies
- [Cybersecurity](https://brigita.co/cybersecurity): Risk assessment, threat detection, compliance management, and incident response services
- [Quality Engineering & QA](https://brigita.co/quality-engineering): Test automation, performance testing, API testing, mobile testing, and security testing
- [UX/UI Design](https://brigita.co/creatives-ux-ui-2): User research, UI design, prototyping with Figma, and responsive design solutions
- [Digital Marketing](https://brigita.co/digital-marketing): SEO, PPC campaigns, social media strategy, email automation, and HubSpot integration

## Proprietary AI Platforms

- [BriGEN GenAI Suite](https://brigita.co/brigen-genai-suite): Enterprise GenAI suite featuring AI agents, LLM orchestration, RAG systems, and intelligent automation pipelines
- [Nockpoint](https://brigita.co/nockpoint): AI app engine for rapid development and deployment of generative AI applications
- [Warelo](https://brigita.co/warelo): AI readiness platform assessing and optimizing infrastructure, tools, and organizational transformation
- [Vyoma](https://brigita.co/vyoma): ESG and sustainability tracking platform powered by AI for sustainable business growth
- [Milvo](https://brigita.co/milvo): AI-driven enterprise intelligence platform for data-driven business decision-making

## Specialized Solutions

- [Idea-to-Product (I2P)](https://brigita.co/idea-to-product-i2p): End-to-end MVP development, SaaS creation, AI integration, and full-stack implementation
